name: Voice → Task
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Webhook — POST /webhook/voice-intake; triggered by mobile shortcut or Home Assistant
2. HTTP Request (Whisper/STT) — transcribe audio to text if input is audio
3. HTTP Request (LiteLLM) — POST to http://litellm:4000/chat/completions, model=assistant-default
5. IF node — branch on approval_required flag
6. Wait node — approval gate for ambiguous due dates or low-confidence classifications
7. Todoist Create Task — set credentials from TODOIST_API_TOKEN
8. SQLite Insert — write audit row to db/assistant.db jobs table
